{{nihongo|'''Waguri Shrine'''|若栗神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Shimamura|ja|島村 (一宮市)|qid=Q128848556|lt=Shimamura}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|Q270810|qid=Q270810}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}. Its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was Prefectural Shrine. The official name is “Waguri Shrine Hachimangū.” This is because it once bore the name Hachimangū. However, it is more commonly called Waguri Shrine. {{nihongo|'''Waguri Shrine'''|若栗神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

It is the “Waguri Shrine” of {{ill|Haguri District|hu|Haguri körzet|ja|葉栗郡|ko|하구리군 (아이치현)|pl|Powiat Haguri|sr|Област Хагури|zh|葉栗郡|qid=Q1032507}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}} as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}.

== Overview ==
The founding date is said to be during the {{ill|Hakuhō|Q11580612|qid=Q11580612}}, when a local powerful figure of this region, Haguri no Omi Hitomaro, established the shrine to enshrine his ancestor (Ame-oshitara-hiko no Mikoto).

== Enshrined deities ==
* {{ill|Prince Ametarashihiko|ja|天足彦国押人命|qid=Q11443593|lt=Ame-oshitara-hiko no Mikoto}}
*: A prince of {{ill|Emperor Kōshō|Q312841|qid=Q312841}}. It is said that when Emperor Kōshō stayed in this area, he took as consort {{ill|Yosotarashi-hime|Q10869205|qid=Q10869205}}, the daughter of {{ill|Amaoshio no mikoto|Q97613650|qid=Q97613650|lt=Okitsu Yoae no Kimi}}, a local powerful figure. Their child was Ame-oshitara-hiko.
* {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|ar|الإمبراطور أوجين|arz|الامبراطور اوجين|azb|اوجین (ایمپیراتور)|bn|সম্রাট ওজিন|cs|Ódžin|de|Ōjin|es|Ōjin Tennō|eu|Ōjin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور اوجین|fi|Ōjin|fr|Ōjin|hr|Ōjin|id|Kaisar Ōjin|it|Ōjin|ja|応神天皇|ka|ოძინი|ko|오진 천황|nl|Ojin|pl|Ōjin|pt|Ojin|ru|Император Одзин|sh|Car Ōjin|simple|Emperor Ōjin|sl|Cesar Odžin|sv|Ojin|th|จักรพรรดิโอจิง|tl|Emperador Ōjin|tr|Ōjin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Одзін|uz|Imperator Ōjin|vi|Thiên hoàng Ōjin|yo|Emperor Ōjin|zh|应神天皇|zh_min_nan|Ôzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|應神天皇|qid=Q317997}}

== Designated cultural properties of Ichinomiya City ==

== Transportation ==
* Get off at the {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397}} “Waguri Shrine-mae” bus stop; the shrine is just a short walk away.
** From {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|Q2856589|qid=Q2856589}} on the {{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|Q1137838|qid=Q1137838}} or {{ill|Meitetsu Bisai Line|Q901005|qid=Q901005}}, or from {{ill|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|Q871495|qid=Q871495}} on the {{ill|Tōkaidō Line (JR Central)|Q11235139|qid=Q11235139}} of {{ill|Central Japan Railway Company|Q513679|qid=Q513679}}, take a bus bound for “Kawashima” from platform 3 of the Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station Bus Terminal.
